hints.title: Greatest Common Divisor Reduction
hints.text: Every common factor of a and b is a divisor of the greatest common divisor gcd(a, b).

hints.title: Divisor Count
hints.text: Count how many integers from 1 up to g divide g with remainder zero.

hints.title: GCD Factor Counting Implementation

complexity.notes: Euclidean gcd followed by divisor scan up to gcd value.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning up to min(a, b) without computing gcd is unnecessary for large inputs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory operates directly on input integers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies gcd divisor property to count common factors cleanly.
